name: Dante GEO Shield
author: danteix

sections.description:
Dante GEO Shield is a standalone Web Governance, AI Bot Firewall, and Agentic Browsing Suite for WordPress—100% functional locally with zero external account required.

While basic plugins only print a static /llms.txt text file, Dante GEO Shield gives site owners granular control over how AI Search and Model Training crawlers access, verify, and interact with their WordPress site:

  1. AI Bot Firewall (Search vs. Training in robots.txt):
    Set per-bot Allow or Disallow: / policies across 10 major AI crawlers grouped into AI Citation Search (OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, PerplexityBot, Claude-Web) and AI Model Training (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, Applebot-Extended, Bytespider, Amazonbot), including a 1-click “Allow AI Citation Search · Block Model Training” preset.
  2. 100% Local AI Crawler Radar & Top Crawled URLs:
    Track real-time hits from AI crawlers separated by Search vs. Training traffic, inspect the Top 10 AI-Crawled URLs, and view recent crawl timestamps inside a strictly bounded FIFO ring-buffer (<= 500 events / <= 256 KB) with a 1-click log reset.
  3. WordPress Site Health Integration (Tools -> Site Health):
    Registers a native dante_geo_agentic_readiness health check verifying search visibility (blog_public), Search-vs-Training firewall posture, ARD v0.91 and /llms.txt discovery, WebMCP form readiness, and SEO plugin coexistence.
  4. Local Brand Facts & Counter-Hallucination JSON-LD Builder (Organization + FAQPage):
    Declare your official brand summary, verified pricing truth, canonical pricing/contact URL, and up to 5 verified Q&A pairs locally in wp-admin. Automatically emitted into Schema.org JSON-LD (@graph) (escaped safely via wp_print_inline_script_tag() and JSON_HEX_TAG) and /llms.txt.
  5. Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD v0.91) & W3C WebMCP Forms:
    Publishes /.well-known/ard.json (/?dante_ard=1 fallback) and annotates WordPress search forms (get_search_form) with toolname / tooldescription WebMCP attributes for modern agentic browsing audits.
  6. Live Agentic Inspector & Peaceful SEO Coexistence:
    Preview live /llms.txt, /.well-known/ard.json, compiled robots.txt rules, and escaped Schema.org JSON-LD directly inside Settings -> Dante GEO Shield. Automatically detects Yoast SEO, Rank Math, AIOSEO, SEOPress, and WooCommerce without duplicating <title> or <meta> tags.
  7. Optional Dante IX Cloud Sync (Explicit Admin Opt-In Only):
    By default, zero external HTTP requests are made. Administrators can optionally opt in to connect https://danteix.com for multi-model Share of Model (SoM) audits and synchronized schema defense.

External Services Disclosure (WordPress.org Guideline 6 & 7)

By default, Dante GEO Shield operates 100% locally on your installation and transmits zero data to any external server.

When an administrator explicitly clicks “Connect Free Cloud Preview & Audit My Brand Visibility (Opt-In)” or “Save Key & Sync Shield Now” inside Settings -> Dante GEO Shield -> 4. Dante IX Cloud (Opt-In), the plugin communicates with the Dante IX Cloud API (https://danteix.com/api/wp-plugin/v1/register and https://danteix.com/api/wp-plugin/v1/sync) to:
* Register your domain and retrieve your Share of Model (SoM) benchmark.
* Download your cryptographically signed /llms.txt and Schema.org JSON-LD counterweight graph.
* Service Provider: Dante IX (https://danteix.com)
* Terms of Service: https://danteix.com/terms
* Privacy Policy: https://danteix.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the dante-geo-shield folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or upload dante-geo-shield.zip via Plugins -> Add New -> Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu.
  3. Visit Settings -> Dante GEO Shield to configure your AI Bot Firewall (Search vs. Training), declare Local Brand Facts & FAQs, inspect live outputs in Live Agentic Inspector, or view Tools -> Site Health.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require a Dante IX account to work?

No. All AI Bot Firewall rules (robots.txt), AI Crawler Radar metrics, Site Health checks, Brand Facts & FAQ JSON-LD generation, W3C WebMCP search annotations, ARD v0.91 (/.well-known/ard.json), /llms.txt, and the Live Agentic Inspector work 100% locally without any account or external connection.

How can I allow AI search citations while blocking AI training scrapers?

Open Settings -> Dante GEO Shield -> 1. Crawler Radar & Firewall and click “Allow AI Citation Search · Block Model Training”. That sets OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, PerplexityBot, and Claude-Web to Allow while setting GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, Applebot-Extended, Bytespider, and Amazonbot to Disallow: / in robots.txt.

Can I use Dante GEO Shield alongside Yoast SEO, Rank Math, AIOSEO, or SEOPress?

Yes. Dante GEO Shield automatically detects active SEO plugins and operates in complementary coexistence mode without modifying your <title> or <meta> tags.

Does the AI Crawler Radar bloat my database?

No. The local radar uses a strict FIFO ring-buffer capped at a maximum of 500 events (<= 256 KB), and you can clear it anytime with one click.
sections.changelog:
15.3.0

  • Security: Replaced direct <script> concatenation and JSON_UNESCAPED_* flags in JSON-LD and ARD output with wp_print_inline_script_tag(), JSON_HEX_TAG | JSON_HEX_AMP | JSON_HEX_APOS | JSON_HEX_QUOT, recursive JSON sanitization (emit_safe_jsonld_script()), X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff headers, and proper wp_die() HTTP 403 response argument handling (manifest_hash: 0985a51efb5e68d4ffc709e9b6f13d95d52b54d6f063a3c2cc7e4842b6881140).
  • Feature: Added standalone AI Bot Firewall (Search vs. Training robots.txt rules across 10 bots), WordPress Site Health integration (Tools -> Site Health), Local Brand Facts & FAQ JSON-LD / /llms.txt builder, Top 10 AI-Crawled URLs breakdown, radar reset action, and 4-tab wp-admin console with Live Agentic Inspector.

15.2.0

  • Added ARD v0.91 (/.well-known/ard.json) discovery endpoint, W3C WebMCP search form annotations (toolname / tooldescription), and domain-locked 1:1 cloud sync (manifest_hash: a6fe70df1fd762a368a1fe4bf790f55ac29cfa162d617c2c86ac625e82fab85d).

15.1.0

  • WordPress.org Plugin Check (PCP) zero-warning hardening (wp_parse_url(), inline wp_json_encode() and esc_html(), Guideline 17 trademark compliance; manifest_hash: 22c23e00e17d04657117343d64f31fbd79e89002d373f009a30e4e1dea7f7610).

15.0.0

  • Initial commercial & freemium release (manifest_hash: 672ce3abf84223577bcdfa6a869b2044e42fb381afc4adcaf665c5bc2b2e750e).
